map.按车门标贴标准胎压，结合载重与季节核算目标胎压，并对比实测值给出补放气建议。: Takes the standard pressure from the door-jamb label, factors in load and season to derive a target, and compares it against measured readings to advise on inflating or releasing air.
map.建议胎压 = 标贴值 + 载荷修正 + 季节修正：满载 +0.2 bar、半载: Recommended pressure = label value + load correction + seasonal correction: fully loaded +0.2 bar, half load +0.1, unladen 0; winter +0.1, summer −0.05; each axle corrected against its own label value.
map.轴荷增加，接地印痕变大: Higher axle load and a larger contact patch
map.抑制胎侧过度变形与发热: Limits excessive sidewall flex and heat build-up
map.低温冷缩，抵消约 0.1 bar 降幅: Cold shrinkage offsets about a 0.1 bar drop
map.行驶升温，避免热态超压: Temperature rises while driving; avoid hot over-pressure
map.1 bar = 100 kPa = 14.5038 psi ≈ 1.0197 k: 1 bar = 100 kPa = 14.5038 psi ≈ 1.0197 kgf/cm². Labels often list both bar and psi, so convert before inflating when your compressor reads another unit.
map.胎压须在冷胎（停车 3 小时以上或行驶不足 2km）时测量；刚跑完高速的热态读数: Pressure must be read cold (parked over 3 hours or driven under 2km); a hot reading straight off the highway runs 0.2~0.3 bar high and cannot be compared with the label directly.
map.💡 前后轴通常不同（前驱车前轮略高）。四轮独立、胎压监测灯亮起时，请逐轮核对并复: 💡 Front and rear usually differ (front is higher on front-wheel-drive cars). With four independently monitored tires and the TPMS lamp on, check each wheel and then reset the system.
map.📚 深度解析：标准胎压查询与核算: 📚 In-depth: Looking Up and Computing Standard Tire Pressure
map.按车门框标贴或手册的标准胎压，结合载重与季节微调，保证抓地与舒适。: Take the standard pressure from the door-jamb label or manual, then fine-tune for load and season to balance grip and comfort.
map.换季或满载长途前核对并补足胎压，降低爆胎与偏磨。: Before a season change or a long trip fully loaded, check and top up pressure to cut blowout and uneven wear risks.
map.对比前后轴差异（前驱车前轮常略高），统一调整。: Compare the two axles (front is often higher on front-wheel-drive cars) and adjust them together.
map.按标贴与载重微调: Fine-tuning from the label and load
map.标贴推荐前 2.3、后 2.1 bar（空载）。满载或高速可整体上调 0.1–0: The label recommends front 2.3 and rear 2.1 bar (unladen). Fully loaded or sustained high-speed running allows +0.1–0.2 bar across the board; winter adds about 0.1 bar to offset contraction. Readings of 2.0 front and 1.9 rear call for a top-up to standard, otherwise consumption and wear climb.
map.胎压高好还是低好？: Is higher or lower tire pressure better?
map.过低费油、胎肩磨损、易驻波爆胎；过高中央磨损、颠簸抓地降。以厂家标贴为准，按载重: Too low wastes fuel, wears the shoulders and risks standing-wave blowouts; too high wears the center, rides harsh and reduces grip. Follow the manufacturer's label with load adjustments, not guesswork.
map.备胎胎压为什么更高？: Why is the spare inflated higher?
map.非全尺寸备胎常要求 4.0–4.2 bar 以防久置亏气，仅限临时短途低速使用，: Space-saver spares commonly need 4.0–4.2 bar to counter slow loss over long storage; they are for temporary low-speed use only, so get the road tire repaired promptly after fitting.
map.胎压须在冷胎状态测量，热胎读数不能直接对照标贴标准: Measure pressure cold; a hot reading cannot be compared directly with the label standard
